study: Premarket-level power bar (operator-pasted YouTube setup, 2026-10-23): mark the premarket high (PMH) and low (PML); after the open, on 2-minute bars, a large-bodied candle that ORIGINATES at or near one level and pushes AWAY from it (green off PML = long, red off PMH = short); enter as it closes, stop beyond the bar, target the opposite premarket level.
registered_at: 2026-10-23, before any script, feature or outcome
batch: untested-categories 2026-10-23; #10, added after the operator pasted the video
origin: Operator pasted a transcript (same presenter as the fence-bar video): 'over the past 12 trading days this setup appeared 9 times and worked 8'; SPY-priced chart (~$577), 2-minute bars; breakouts THROUGH a level are skipped; a 'wild' 04:00 candle is ignored (discretionary).
prior: LOW (~10%): 8/9 over 12 days is an anecdote (one losing streak can hide in 12 days); PMH/level entries tested 10/2 did not beat random minutes; but a reversal-away-from-the-level rule with a large-body trigger on index ETFs has not been tested.
instruments: PRIMARY: SPY and QQQ. INFORMATION: the warehouse universe cannot be used (RTH-only bars, no premarket).
data: SIP 1-minute bars 04:00-15:59 ET for SPY and QQQ, 2016-01-04 .. 2026-10-15, data-only Alpaca account (Adjustment.ALL), paced, cached under ai_reports/pm_power_bar/ (shares the fence_bar RTH fetch where possible). Early-close sessions dropped and counted. A day with fewer than 30 premarket 1-minute bars is dropped and counted.

rule.levels: PMH / PML = the highest high / lowest low of 1-minute bars 04:00-09:29. Declared mechanical version of 'ignore a wild 04:00 candle': levels use 07:00-09:29 (information: 04:00-09:29). If PMH - PML < 0.1% of PML the day is skipped (counted).
rule.bars: 2-minute bars on clock boundaries from 09:30 (09:30-09:31 is bar 1), built from 1-minute bars (both present, else missing).
rule.power_bar: A 2-minute bar with RANGE >= 2.0 x the median 2-minute range of the PREVIOUS session's RTH 2-minute bars, BODY >= 60% of its range; LONG: close > open and close in the top 20% of the range; SHORT: close < open and close in the bottom 20%.
rule.origin: LONG: the bar's LOW is within 0.15% of PML (|low - PML| <= 0.0015 x PML) - it originates at or near the low. SHORT: the bar's HIGH within 0.15% of PMH.
rule.not_a_breakout: LONG requires the bar's close > PML (pushing away, not breaking down); SHORT requires close < PMH. A close beyond the level on the far side is a breakout: no trade (as the video skips breakouts).
rule.window: The power bar must end by 10:30 ET. First qualifying bar of the day per side; one trade per symbol per day (the first side to trigger; the other side is information).
rule.entry: The open of the first 1-minute bar after the power bar ends.
rule.stop: LONG: the power bar's low - $0.01; exit at min(stop, bar open) on the first 1-minute bar whose low <= stop. SHORT mirrored.
rule.target: LONG: PMH; filled when a 1-minute high >= PMH + $0.01 (or at the bar open if it opens above). If the entry open is already >= PMH (or <= the stop) the trade is skipped (counted). A bar that reaches both counts as the STOP.
rule.time_exit: 15:59 bar close if neither is hit (the video is usually done by 10:00; a 10:30 exit is information).

control: For each trade, a seeded random entry minute in (power-bar end + 1) .. (power-bar end + 60) on the same symbol-day (seed sha256(sym|day|'pmpb-ctrl')), same direction, same PERCENT stop and target distances, same 15:59 exit and fill rules; a second control ('pmpb-ctrl2') for the MDE.
cost: 2 bp round trip binding (SPY/QQQ); 1, 5, 10 bp printed.
primary: LONG trades on SPY + QQQ (desk is long-only). Per half: per day, the mean of (a) trade net and (b) trade minus control (SPY and QQQ on one day = one cluster); day-equal; day-clustered t.
pass: In BOTH halves: mean long net (after 2 bp) > 0 with t >= 2.0, AND long minus control >= +5 bp with t >= 2.0, AND dropping the 3 best days keeps both >= 0. Batch reading t >= 2.73 both halves.
fail: t <= -2 on either primary quantity in a half, or the 97.5% upper bound of long minus control below +5 bp in both halves; otherwise UNDERPOWERED.
power: Outcome-blind count step: long trades and days per half, MDE from (control - control2); floors per half >= 150 trades and >= 100 days (the setup is rare: ~1 per 2 days per symbol claimed; declared lower floor) and MDE <= 5 bp, else UNDERPOWERED.
information_only: the video's claimed rate: share of setup days that hit the target before the stop
no_retuning: Level window, 2.0x range, 60% body, 20% close zone, 0.15% origin band, 10:30 window, stop, target, cost, halves and floors are fixed.
declared_deviations: 'large-bodied / stands out' and 'near the level' are discretionary; the numeric thresholds above are the mechanical reading, fixed before data
the video sometimes moves the stop to break-even (discretionary, not modelled)

amended.when: 2026-10-23, after result-skeptic round 1 FIX FIRST (fence_bar), before any script or data. Applied to pm_power_bar by analogy before its own review.
changes: (1) HELD-OUT: 2026-01-14 .. 2026-04-24 is removed from half B (and SMA warm-up bars from that window are not used: the SMA restarts on 2026-04-27 and needs 20 bars before the first trade). Half B = 2021-01-04 .. 2026-01-13 and 2026-04-27 .. 2026-10-15. That window is the ETF CONFIRMATION read after a PASS.
(2) PRIMARY LONG SET = every long trigger regardless of the short side (the 'first side' clause applies only to the information short set).

(3) FILLS: the stop fills at min(stop, bar open) for longs and max(stop, bar open) for shorts; the target fills at the target (or the bar open if it opens beyond); long target needs high >= target + $0.01, short target low <= target - $0.01. The ENTRY minute's own high/low is checked for stop and target. A bar that touches both counts as the STOP.

(4) BATCH: the batch now has 11 studies (8 + fence_bar + pm_power_bar + anchor_power_bar); batch-robust needs t >= 2.84 in both halves (Bonferroni 0.05/11, two-sided normal). 'Long minus control >= +5 bp with t >= 2.0': t is against 0; the point estimate must be >= +5 bp.
(5) POWER: floors are on DAYS - >= 300 days with a long trade per half (QQQ and SPY on one day are one cluster); MDE = (2.0 + 0.84) x SD(day mean of control - control2) / sqrt(days); MDE <= 5 bp.

(6) SEQUENCING: (a) a missing bar between breakout and retest does not cancel; the sequence continues on the next present bar. (b) bar boundaries are America/New_York clock time. (c) dropped early-close sessions contribute no bars to the SMA (the series skips them). (d) Last eligible trigger bar ends at the window end stated in the rule; entry at the next minute's open.
(7) Information: drop the best calendar month (March 2020 sits in half A). Declared: the desk runs on IEX with no ETF trade path; a PASS goes only to a forward paper prereg.
(6b) pm_power_bar window: the last eligible power bar is 10:28-10:29; entry at the 10:30 open. Day floor: >= 150 long-trade days per half (rarer setup, declared).
